products.notes: KO FIELD NOT RECOVERABLE — lifting_height LEFT NULL, FLAGGED. The p.2 spec table does NOT state a lift height anywhere (Performance block covers payload, drive type, turning radius, ground clearance, speed, lifting SPEED 250 mm/s, position accuracy, navigation, dead weight — no lift height). The lift height exists only as callouts on the p.2 CAD drawing, which is headed 'MONO MAST' and 'DUPLEX MAST' with the note 'mono lift fully extended' appearing twice. Positioned-text extraction recovers the drawing callouts '2604', '2479', '1000' (horizontal) and '5381' plus a garbled overlapping '5,4062' (rotated/vertical dimension lines), but PDF page rendering is unavailable in this environment (pdftoppm/poppler not installed), so these could not be matched to their dimension lines visually and no lift height can be responsibly assigned. NOTE FOR THE REVIEWER: the existing DB value lifting_height=3205 does NOT appear anywhere in this document's extracted text or in any recovered drawing callout — it is neither confirmed nor contradicted here, and should be re-verified against a rendered page. NOT MAPPED — AP0 SCOPE GAP (second occurrence in this session, after Grenzebach FF1200S): p.2 prints 'Turning radius (m) 1.5' with an explicit, unambiguous 'Turning radius' label (safe to map under the established radius-vs-diameter rule), but there is NO turning-radius field in 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift' scope — turning_radius is Tugger-only and min_turning_radius is AMR-only. The value 1500 mm (converted from the printed 1.5 m) is recorded here in prose only and could not be written to any field. NOT MAPPED — WRONG-SCOPE TRAP AVOIDED: p.2 prints 'Ground clearance min. (mm) 30'. min_ground_clearance is AMR-scope only and, per its AP0 hint, holds the ROBOT HEIGHT for under-ride workflows, not the gap beneath the chassis — so this 30 mm figure is doubly unmappable here (wrong scope AND wrong semantics). NOT MAPPED — other: 'Drive type Tricycle' (a wheel arrangement; AP0 drive_type allowed_values are Counterbalanced / Reach Truck / Straddle Stacker / Pallet Mover / VNA Turret, none of which is stated); mast_type (the drawing offers BOTH a mono mast (≈Simplex) and a duplex mast, but mast_type is a single-value Dropdown and the sheet does not say which is standard); 'Lifting speed (mm/s) 250', 'Dead weight (kg) 3 500', 'Charging power (kW) 3 / 6', 'Battery usable capacity [85% SoC] 11.75 kWh', 'Visual safety LED strip', 'Emergency stop button', 'Floor spot Front / Side', 'Key panel', '10" touch display', 'Wifi' — no AP0 field for any of these (note: onboard_ui, which would fit the key panel + 10" display, is AMR-scope only and therefore invalid on this Forklift AGV). 'Collision avoidance  Coming soon' explicitly marks the feature as NOT YET AVAILABLE, so autonomous_obstacle_bypass was left null rather than true. 'Floor conditions  Can withstand floor irregularity' names no flatness standard or value, so floor_flatness_req was left null per its AP0 NULL RULE. SCOPE BUG IN EXISTING DB ROW (pre-existing): this product is product_type='Forklift AGV' but carries grid_required=0, which is scope 'Logistics:AGV:AMR' — not valid on a Forklift AGV. Flagged, not corrected.

products.notes: CONFLICTS (existing DB values NOT overwritten): (1) max_payload DB=2721 kg vs datasheet 3000 kg (p.2, 'Payload (tons) Up to 3'). Unit forensics per the standing check: 2721 kg is EXACTLY 6000 lb (6000 × 0.45359237 = 2721.55), so the DB value is almost certainly a US-market spec converted from pounds, not an independent measurement or a transcription error — i.e. this looks like a genuine market/variant difference (a 6000 lb US rating vs a 3 t EU rating), not a data-entry mistake. Needs a Tech Lead decision on which rating the DB should carry; do not silently overwrite. (2) max_speed DB=1.1 m/s vs datasheet 1.5 m/s (p.2, 'Max. speed (m/s) Up to 1.5'). Note the DB also carries 1.1 for PF6 and 1.3 for PF280, so 1.1 is not obviously a copy artifact. (3) omnidirectional_movement DB=true vs datasheet-implied FALSE — p.2 states 'Drive type  Tricycle' AND 'Turning radius (m) 1.7'. A tricycle-drive vehicle with a 1.7 m turning radius is by definition not holonomic; both facts independently contradict omnidirectional operation. (4) rotation_capable DB=true vs datasheet-implied FALSE — same two rows; a vehicle needing 1.7 m of turning radius cannot rotate on the spot. Conflicts (3) and (4) apply identically to the DB's PF6, PF30 and PF280 rows, which all carry omnidirectional_movement=1 and rotation_capable=1 — worth checking those too even though only PF3 has a datasheet here. WRONG-SCOPE TRAP AVOIDED (important): p.2 prints 'Ground clearance min. (mm)  30'. This was deliberately NOT written to min_ground_clearance. The AP0 hint defines min_ground_clearance as the ROBOT HEIGHT / clearance needed to drive UNDER the carrier ('Source: vehicle height spec'), i.e. it holds the vehicle's own height, not the gap beneath its chassis. Writing 30 here would have understated the field by a factor of ~12 on a KO_IF_LT field. The 350 mm drawing callout was used instead. DRAWING-CALLOUT CAVEAT (applies to vehicle_length, vehicle_width, min_ground_clearance): p.2 carries three unlabelled dimension callouts — 350, 996 and 1750 mm — on the product drawing. PDF page rendering is unavailable in this environment (pdftoppm/poppler not installed), so these were recovered as positioned text via pdfplumber rather than read visually against their dimension lines. Axis assignment is therefore an inference from magnitude and vehicle type (a 3-tonne flat transport platform with 30 mm ground clearance and a 615 kg dead weight): 350 = height, 996 = width, 1750 = length. min_ground_clearance is a KO field, so this one in particular should be visually re-verified before import. ADD-ON CAVEAT (lift_height): the recorded 100 mm comes from the 'Add-ons' column ('Lift unit (stroke +100 mm)'), NOT from the base configuration. The base PF3 is a flat transport platform, which under the AP0 lift_height hint ('0 for non-lifting transport tops') would be 0. Recorded as 100 because the capability is offered, but a reviewer should decide whether an add-on capability belongs in a KO_IF_LT field on the base model. Related and ambiguous: an isolated 'Height: 400 mm' appears in the same Add-ons region of p.2, adjacent to 'Lift unit (stroke +100 mm)' and 'Remote control' — the two-column layout makes it impossible to tell whether 400 mm is the add-on lift unit's own height, the raised deck height, or an unrelated Installation-environment value. Left unmapped. NOT MAPPED — other: 'Drive type Tricycle' (not an AP0 drive_type allowed value, and drive_type is Forklift-scope anyway so invalid here); 'Dead weight (kg) 615'; 'Charging power (kW) 3'; 'Battery usable capacity [85% SoC] 3.7 kWh'; 'Emergency stop button'; 'Visual safety LED strip'; 'Add-ons interface'; 'Wireless communication Wifi (standard) / 5G (option)'; 'Remote control' — no AP0 field for any of these. 'Collision avoidance  On request' is both optional and non-committal, so autonomous_obstacle_bypass left null. 'Floor conditions  Can withstand floor irregularity' names no standard, so floor_flatness_req left null per its NULL RULE. SCOPE BUG IN EXISTING DB ROW (pre-existing): this product is product_type='Mobile AMR' but carries vna_capable=0 and stacking_capability=0, both of which exist only in scope 'Logistics:AGV:Forklift'. The same two out-of-scope fields appear on the PF6, PF30 and PF280 rows. Flagged, not corrected.
